Celtic: Martin O'Neill vows to 'sort out' striking options ahead of Premiership trip to Falkirk, live on Sky
The Hoops are four points clear at the top of the Scottish Premiership; Camilo Duran is the club's top scorer this season; watch Falkirk vs Celtic on Sunday, live on Sky Sports from 12.30pm
Friday 30 October 2026 15:11, UK
Martin O'Neill agrees with Celtic skipper Callum McGregor's questioning of his striking selections and insists they will "sort it out".
The Hoops started the Scottish Premiership game against Dundee United with three centre-forwards: Callum Osmand, Kasper Hogh and Camilo Duran.
Then, when Celtic were 2-1 down at half-time, O'Neill took off Osmand and Hogh, moved scorer Duran into the middle and brought on wingers Jota and Hasseim Hassan.
Celtic pegged back the visitors to 2-2 to remain four points clear of Rangers at the top of the table but while they are, as usual, in a strong position in the league, they have lost all three of their Europa League games.
After the United game, McGregor said of the three striking positions: "It's not really having a nailed-on profile for each of the positions. The players behave like a winger, or they behave like a striker.
"You can get away with it for a few games but if it's a striker playing as a winger, you are going to get that behaviour a lot of the time.
"You've got enough quality so you can score goals and get away with it. But we have to try to get the team functioning the way it should.
"Then that will alleviate all the other problems that we are encountering, where it becomes a bit basketball, you lose control and spend the next 15 minutes trying to get possession back."
With title rivals Rangers and Hearts involved in Scottish League Cup semi-finals at Hampden Park this weekend, Celtic have the chance to go seven points clear when they travel to Falkirk on Sunday, live on Sky Sports.
O'Neill said: "I've said this to you before, I totally agree that Osmand is actually really a centre forward. I've said it at the press conference, that he is essentially a centre forward who probably would play off somebody strong alongside him.
"Not so sure that he could lead the line on his own. And that Duran is really a centre forward.
"So the players are getting to know each other. It's really as simple as that. So I'm in total agreement with Callum. We'll sort it out.
"We seem to be doing okay domestically, trying to sort it out.
"There's a few players that haven't had a chance. (Jordan) Lotomba hasn't had a chance yet to play. There'll be moments, absolutely. There'll be people in the squad.
"Young (Joel) van den Berg, again, has trained today. And so over the course of the next number of weeks, between now and Christmas, I think everybody will be on the field of play.
"And then it's a matter of establishing, right positions as much as possible.
"Players have played out of position before. Don't know whether it was a big issue when young Osmand came on in the Benfica game and set us alight."

מאמן סלטיק, מרטין או'ניל, הגיב לביקורת שהשמיע קפטן הקבוצה קאלום מקגרגור בנוגע לבחירת שחקני ההתקפה של הקבוצה. או'ניל אישר כי יש מקום לשיפור ולסידור נכון של העמדות במגרש, במיוחד לאור האתגרים בליגה המקומית ובמסגרת האירופית.

למרות הצלחתה היחסית בליגה הסקוטית, הקבוצה סבלה מקשיים מסוימים בתפקוד ההתקפי ובהתאמת השחקנים לתפקידיהם הטבעיים. או'ניל ציין כי השחקנים עדיין לומדים להכיר זה את זה וכי הסגל יעבור התאמות בקרוב.

הקבוצה מתכוננת למשחק הבא מול פלקירק מתוך מטרה להגדיל את הפער בפסגת הטבלה. המאמן הדגיש כי שחקנים נוספים צפויים לקבל הזדמנויות להוכיח את עצמם במהלך השבועות הקרובים עד חג המולד.
